prompt: 哪一句才是正確的商務英文？
options: Please send me the report by Friday.
Please send me the report until Friday.
Please send me the report at Friday.
Please send me the report in Friday.
answer: Please send me the report by Friday.

until 表示動作一直持續到某時間，send 是一次性動作，要用 by 表示期限。
at 用於時刻或定點（at 5 p.m.），星期要用 on 或搭配 by。
in 用於月份、年份或一段時間之後，星期幾不用 in。

why: by + 時間表示最晚期限，適合一次性的動作。
tip: 期限用 by，持續到用 until。
say: Please send me the report by Friday.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The new office manager will be _____ for approving all travel expenses.
options: responsible
responsive
respectful
respective

wrong.responsive: responsive 是「反應快的」，不能和 for approving 組成「負責」。
wrong.respectful: respectful 是「尊敬的」，用於人對人的態度，不表示職責。
wrong.respective: respective 是「各自的」，不能作敘述補語搭配 for。

why: be responsible for 是「負責……」，TOEIC 常考。
tip: be responsible for + 名詞或 V-ing。
say: The new office manager will be responsible for approving all travel expenses.

prompt: 客戶來信問貨什麼時候到，你想回覆：「出貨後我會立刻通知您。」哪一句最合適？
options: I will notify you as soon as the order ships.
I will notify you as soon as the order will ship.
I notify you as soon as the order is shipping now.
I will be notify you as soon as the order ships.
answer: I will notify you as soon as the order ships.

wrong.I will notify you as soon as the order w: as soon as 引導的時間子句用現在式，不加 will。
wrong.I notify you as soon as the order is shi: 主句要表示未來承諾，應用 will notify；is shipping now 也與未來時間不符。
wrong.I will be notify you as soon as the orde: will be 後面不能接原形 notify，會形成錯誤的動詞組合。

why: 主句用 will 表示承諾，as soon as 的子句用現在式。
tip: 時間子句用現在式代替未來式。
say: I will notify you as soon as the order ships.

prompt: 這封通知最想表達什麼？
text: Due to the system upgrade, the online portal will be unavailable from 10 p.m. to 2 a.m. on Saturday.
options: 因為系統升級，入口網站週六晚上十點到凌晨兩點無法使用。
入口網站週六全天都可以使用。
系統升級後網站會永遠關閉。
網站只有週六凌晨兩點到晚上十點無法使用。
answer: 因為系統升級，入口網站週六晚上十點到凌晨兩點無法使用。

wrong.入口網站週六全天都可以使用。: unavailable 是無法使用，且有特定時段，和全天可用相反。
wrong.系統升級後網站會永遠關閉。: 通知只提到暫時時段，並沒有說會永久關閉。
wrong.網站只有週六凌晨兩點到晚上十點無法使用。: 把時間顛倒了：10 p.m. to 2 a.m. 是晚上到隔天凌晨。

why: due to 說明原因，from ... to ... 指出無法使用的時段。
tip: due to + 原因；unavailable = 無法使用。
say: Due to the system upgrade, the online portal will be unavailable from 10 p.m. to 2 a.m. on Saturday.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的商務英文？
options: The invoice must be paid within thirty days.
The invoice must pay within thirty days.
The invoice must be paying within thirty days.
The invoice must be paid in thirty days ago.
answer: The invoice must be paid within thirty days.

發票是被支付的，要用被動語態 be paid。
wrong.The invoice must be paying within thirty: be paying 是進行式，不是被動語態，而且發票不會自己付款。
wrong.The invoice must be paid in thirty days: ago 表示過去，與 must 表示未來的要求衝突。

why: 發票被支付，所以用 must be paid；within 表示在期限內。
tip: must be + p.p. 表示必須被做。
say: The invoice must be paid within thirty days.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The sales team exceeded its quarterly target, _____ the company to raise its annual forecast.
options: allowing
allowed
allows
allow

wrong.allowed: allowed 作過去分詞表被動，但這裡主動使結果發生，要用 allowing。
wrong.allows: allows 是第三人稱單數動詞，一個句子不能出現兩個主要動詞而沒有連接詞。
wrong.allow: allow 是原形，無法作為句子後面表結果的分詞。

why: 逗號後的分詞片語表示結果，主動意義要用現在分詞 allowing。
tip: 分詞片語可補充結果：, V-ing ...
say: The sales team exceeded its quarterly target, allowing the company to raise its annual forecast.

prompt: 你要寫電子郵件請同事追蹤供應商的回覆。哪一句最合適？
options: Could you follow up with the supplier about the delay?
Could you following up the supplier about the delay?
Could you follow the supplier up for the delay about?
Could you to follow up with the supplier about the delay?
answer: Could you follow up with the supplier about the delay?

wrong.Could you following up the supplier abou: Could you 後面接原形 follow，不能用 following；follow up 後也要用 with 接人。
wrong.Could you follow the supplier up for the: 片語順序亂掉，about 不能放在句尾。
wrong.Could you to follow up with the supplier: 助動詞 could 後面不加 to。

why: follow up with + 人 about + 事情，是商務郵件常用說法。
tip: follow up with 人 about 事。
say: Could you follow up with the supplier about the delay?

text: Profit margins improved because the company negotiated lower prices with its suppliers.
options: 因為公司和供應商談到較低價格，利潤率提高了。
因為利潤率提高，公司把價格調高。
因為公司漲價，供應商利潤提高。
公司沒有和供應商談價格，利潤率仍提高了。
answer: 因為公司和供應商談到較低價格，利潤率提高了。

wrong.因為利潤率提高，公司把價格調高。: 因果顛倒；原句 because 後面才是原因（談到低價）。
wrong.因為公司漲價，供應商利潤提高。: 原句談的是進貨價格降低，不是公司漲價。
wrong.公司沒有和供應商談價格，利潤率仍提高了。: 原句明確說 negotiated，有談價格。

why: because 後面是原因：談到較低進貨價，結果是利潤率提高。
say: Profit margins improved because the company negotiated lower prices with its suppliers.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的商務英文？
options: We are looking forward to meeting you next week.
We are looking forward to meet you next week.
We look forward meeting you next week.
We are looking forward to meeting with you next week at.
answer: We are looking forward to meeting you next week.

wrong.We are looking forward to meet you next: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing 而不是原形。
look forward 後面需要 to，缺少介系詞。
wrong.We are looking forward to meeting with y: 句尾的 at 多餘，沒有後面的地點，結構不完整。

why: look forward to 後面接名詞或 V-ing。
tip: look forward to 後面接 V-ing。
say: We are looking forward to meeting you next week.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Employees should submit their expense reports _____ the end of each month.
options: by
since
during
among

wrong.since: since 表示從過去某時間起，不用於未來期限。
wrong.during: during 後接一段期間，表示期間內持續，而不是截止時間。
wrong.among: among 是「在……之中」，不能表示時間期限。

why: submit 是一次性動作，by the end of ... 表示最遲期限。
tip: by the end of = 在……結束前。
say: Employees should submit their expense reports by the end of each month.

prompt: 同事說：「如果價格下降，我們就能擴大訂單。」你想用英文確認什麼條件才算成立。哪一句最合適？
options: What conditions would need to be true for that to work?
What conditions are need to be true for that to work?
Which condition is needed to true for working that?
What condition would needing to be true for that work?
answer: What conditions would need to be true for that to work?

wrong.What conditions are need to be true for: are need 把 be 動詞和 need 混用，條件在這裡要說 would need to be true。
wrong.Which condition is needed to true for wo: to true 缺少 be 動詞，for working that 的語序也不自然。
wrong.What condition would needing to be true: would 後面不能接 needing，應為原形 need；for that work 也缺少 to。

why: would need to be true 是假設情境中詢問必要條件的自然說法。
tip: 問條件：what would need to be true?
say: What conditions would need to be true for that to work?
